s2.ptxt: Raise the rear wiper blade to the position shown in the illustration until it clicks and the claw disengages.

atten3.ptxt: Be careful not to damage the claw.

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear wiper blade from the rear wiper arm assembly as shown in the illustration.

atten3.ptxt: To prevent damage to the back door glass, place a cloth or similar between the back door glass and the rear wiper arm assembly.

s2.ptxt: As shown in the illustration, let the rear wiper rubber protrude past the stopper on the rear end side of the rear wiper blade, and pull it out.

atten3.ptxt: Do not force the rear wiper rubber out, as this may deform the rear wiper rubber backing plate and damage the claws of the rear wiper blade.

atten4.ptxt: Lightly pressing (squeezing) near the center between the claws of the rear wiper blade lifts the rear wiper rubber, making it easier to pull out.

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear wiper rubber together with the rear wiper rubber backing plate.
Remove the rear wiper rubber from the rear wiper rubber backing plate.
